reasoning_content: The server name is set within the VirtualHost configuration. The "Could not reliably determine" message is merely a warning. Let's verify whether Apache actually started and is listening.

action.command: ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ":8080" ; ps aux | grep "[a]pache2" | wc -l; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "root: HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/
